info.name: E7GZ PS — Sprint 0 API tests
info.description:
Every endpoint that works at the end of Sprint 0 (E7-12 … E7-14), plus the security rules around them.

**Before running:** start the backend locally (see tools/postman/README.md), run `seed-test-accounts.sql` once, then use the Collection Runner on the whole collection (the OTP-attempt and rate-limit loops need the Runner).

**Manual step:** after folder 2 registers customer A, copy the 6-digit code from the backend log into the collection variable `otpCode`; otherwise the phone-verification request is skipped.

exec: pm.test("[all] X-Correlation-Id header is a UUID", () =>
pm.test("[all] Envelope has meta.correlationId matching the header", () =>
pm.test("[all] Error body has a code and no message / stack trace", () => {

item.name: 0 · Platform & security basics
item.description: Things that must hold for every request: docs and actuator are not public, the error envelope never leaks internals, the correlation ID is echoed.

item.name: Swagger / OpenAPI docs are not public
Swagger UI is not public
Actuator is not public
Correlation ID sent by the client is echoed
A malformed correlation ID is replaced by a new UUID
Unknown API route without a token is 401 (no route discovery)
1 · Public discovery (Sprint 1 stubs → 501)
item.description: Public routes need no token. They are contract stubs until E7-23 / E7-34, so 501 is the expected answer. When those tasks merge, change these tests to 200.

item.name: GET areas (public)

exec: pm.test("data is the list of active areas", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.be.an("array"));

item.name: GET venues (public)
GET venues without the required activity → 400
GET venues with an unknown activity → 400
GET venues map (public)
GET find-available (public)
GET venue by id (public)
A bad Bearer token is ignored on public routes

exec: pm.test("data is the list of active areas", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.be.an("array"));

item.name: 2 · Customer registration & phone OTP
item.description: FR-ACC-01…06 and the OTP limits (arch 10 §2.4). Each run uses new random phones and usernames. SMS goes to the backend log while E7GZ_SMS_PROVIDER=log.

item.name: Register: invalid phone → 400
Register: weak password (no digit) → 400
Register: password too short → 400
Register: invalid email → 400
Register: empty body → 400
Register customer A → 201

request.description: After this request, find the line `DEV SMS to +20…: OTP 123456` in the backend log and put the code in the collection variable `otpCode` (used in folder 3).

exec: console.log("Customer A phone " + pm.collectionVariables.get("phoneA") + ": copy its OTP from the backend log into the otpCode variable");

item.name: Register: same username, other case and spaces → 422 USERNAME_TAKEN
Register: same phone written as +20… → 422 PHONE_TAKEN
Resend OTP within 60 s → 429 OTP_RESEND_TOO_SOON
Resend OTP for a phone with no pending account → 404
Resend OTP with an invalid phone → 400
Verify: malformed code → 400 (costs no attempt)
Verify: unknown challenge → 422 OTP_INVALID
Register customer B (for the attempt limit) → 201
Verify B with a wrong code (repeats 5×) → 422 OTP_INVALID

request.description: Loops itself 5 times in the Collection Runner. Sent alone it runs once.

item.name: Verify B a 6th time → 429 OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED
3 · Customer login, refresh rotation, logout
item.description: arch 10 §2.3: 15-minute JWT, rotating refresh token, reuse revokes the chain.

item.name: Login unverified customer A by username → 200 (FR-ACC-03)

exec: pm.test("JWT lives exactly 15 minutes", () => pm.expect(claims.exp - claims.iat).to.eql(900));
pm.test("Refresh token is opaque (not a JWT)", () => pm.expect(d.refreshToken.split(".").length).to.eql(1));

item.name: Login customer A by phone in 0020… form → 200
Login with a wrong password → 401
Login with an unknown username → 401 (same answer, no enumeration)
Login with an empty body → 400
Refresh → 200 with a NEW refresh token (rotation)

exec: pm.test("JWT lives exactly 15 minutes", () => pm.expect(claims.exp - claims.iat).to.eql(900));
pm.test("Refresh token is opaque (not a JWT)", () => pm.expect(d.refreshToken.split(".").length).to.eql(1));

item.name: Reuse the OLD refresh token → 401 (reuse detected)
The NEW token was revoked by the reuse → 401 (whole chain revoked)
Login again → fresh session

exec: pm.test("JWT lives exactly 15 minutes", () => pm.expect(claims.exp - claims.iat).to.eql(900));
pm.test("Refresh token is opaque (not a JWT)", () => pm.expect(d.refreshToken.split(".").length).to.eql(1));

item.name: Customer refresh token as the VENUE cookie → 401 (other audience)
…and it still works on the customer refresh → 200

exec: pm.test("JWT lives exactly 15 minutes", () => pm.expect(claims.exp - claims.iat).to.eql(900));
pm.test("Refresh token is opaque (not a JWT)", () => pm.expect(d.refreshToken.split(".").length).to.eql(1));

item.name: Logout → 204
Refresh after logout → 401
Login again (token for folder 4)

exec: pm.test("JWT lives exactly 15 minutes", () => pm.expect(claims.exp - claims.iat).to.eql(900));
pm.test("Refresh token is opaque (not a JWT)", () => pm.expect(d.refreshToken.split(".").length).to.eql(1));

item.name: Verify customer A's phone with the SMS code → 200 + tokens (needs otpCode)

request.description: Manual step: set the collection variable `otpCode` to the 6-digit code from the backend log (`DEV SMS to …: OTP ……`). Skipped automatically when it is empty.

exec: console.log("otpCode not set: skipping phone verification (copy the code from the backend log)");
pm.test("JWT lives exactly 15 minutes", () => pm.expect(claims.exp - claims.iat).to.eql(900));
pm.test("Refresh token is opaque (not a JWT)", () => pm.expect(d.refreshToken.split(".").length).to.eql(1));

item.name: After verification there is no code to resend → 404
4 · Route groups: each accepts only its own token
item.description: arch 09 §1.1: /customer, /venue and /admin each accept only their own identity type.

item.name: No token on a venue route → 401
No token on an admin route → 401
Garbage token → 401
Customer token with a tampered signature → 401
Customer token on a VENUE route → 403
Customer token on an ADMIN route → 403
Customer token on its own group (unknown route) → 404, so the token was accepted
5 · Venue account login (needs seed-test-accounts.sql)
item.description: Shared venue account (FR-VEN-01). A DISABLED account is refused even with the right password (FR-VEN-08).
